brief.purpose: A local-first AI prototype studio that turns a written product idea and DESIGN.md into editable, runnable React interfaces with live preview and version history
brief.concept: A draft sheet or interface frame folding into a four-point spark: ideas becoming polished, runnable UI; optionally hint at modular code blocks through bold negative space
brief.style: Quietly premium, editorial developer-tool aesthetic; simple geometric silhouette, warm and precise, distinctive at 16 px, no letters or text
brief.palette: pine green #347B69, warm ivory #F4F1EA, deep ink #27231E, restrained pale mint accent

candidates.direction: Bold geometric silhouette with memorable negative space and the fewest possible shapes.
candidates.prompt: App: Draftly. Purpose: A local-first AI prototype studio that turns a written product idea and DESIGN.md into editable, runnable React interfaces with live preview and version history. Core symbol: A draft sheet or interface frame folding into a four-point spark: ideas becoming polished, runnable UI; optionally hint at modular code blocks through bold negative space. Visual style: Quietly premium, editorial developer-tool aesthetic; simple geometric silhouette, warm and precise, distinctive at 16 px, no letters or text. Palette: pine green #347B69, warm ivory #F4F1EA, deep ink #27231E, restrained pale mint accent. Create a distinctive, original product icon with simple geometry, excellent silhouette, clear hierarchy, no letters, no words, no watermark, no device mockup, and no UI screenshot. Candidate direction 1: Bold geometric silhouette with memorable negative space and the fewest possible shapes. Render only one standalone brand symbol, centered and front-facing, with no enclosing app tile and no cast shadow. Keep all visible artwork within the central 72 percent of a square canvas. The entire background, including every edge and corner, must be one perfectly uniform flat chroma color #FF00FF. Do not use that chroma color inside the icon.
